direction: Original user-authored hilltop, eye zoom, red world, rival glance, and katana clash. No MotionSites prompts, assets, or code used.

artworks.name: Hill
artworks.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Original cinematic manga illustration for a LocalNinja katana brand website, landscape 16:9, composition designed for a full-screen opening shot. A lone adult swordsman stands on a rugged grassy hill high above a vast Japanese-inspired city at dawn. Detailed old tiled rooftops merge with distant modern towers, mist between districts, power lines, tiny roads, great atmospheric depth. The watcher stands on the RIGHT at x=72%, shown full body in three-quarter rear/profile, facing left toward the city, the side of one sharp eye just visible. Original character: long black hair tied back, dark charcoal kimono jacket and trousers, a long pale ivory scarf blowing left, a sheathed katana with deep emerald green wrapped hilt at waist. The cliff and figure occupy right third; the city spreads beneath across lower two-thirds. Upper LEFT quarter is mostly pale warm ivory sky with subtle ink clouds, intentional open negative space for live text. Black ink, offwhite rice paper, muted slate grey only with a tiny green hilt accent. Premium mature graphic-novel drawing, fine engraved linework and expressive dry brush shadows, realistic anatomy and beautiful detailed architecture, cinematic scale. NOT photorealistic or 3D, not cute or chibi, no recognizable existing characters, no red sun or temple, no letters, no typography, no watermark, no border. An original story's quiet opening before a duel. No violence or wounds.

artworks.name: Eye
artworks.prompt: Create a new extreme cinematic close-up of ONE eye belonging to the black-haired, ivory-scarfed adult swordsman in the reference image. This is a matching original manga story frame. Landscape 16:9. Only the eyebrow, eye, temple and a few black hair strands fill the entire frame. The single eye's round dark pupil is at EXACT center of the image (50 percent x, 50 percent y), important because the website camera will zoom directly into it. The eye occupies 55% of the width. Narrow intense eyelids, realistic male facial anatomy, cool grey iris with a thin muted green ring, a tiny reflected city skyline within the iris. Fine black engraved linework and soft off-white paper, deep black hair and shadows. Same masterful hand-inked detailed drawing style as reference, mature graphic novel, no color except small green iris ring. No gore, no wounds, no text, no borders, no speech bubbles. No entire face or second eye, no collage. Maximum crisp detail around pupil.

artworks.name: Enemy
artworks.prompt: Create a new original enemy reveal scene in the same finely engraved hand-inked manga world as the reference. Landscape 16:9. Entire sky is flat saturated vermilion red #cb2724. A mysterious adult rival swordsman with SHORT swept-back silver hair, a black high-collared cloak, and crimson-red katana handle stands on a tiled rooftop above an intricate monochrome Japanese-inspired city. The rival is at image center, visible head to calf, three-quarter BACK view, head looking away to the RIGHT; we will later animate him glancing toward the viewer. Wind catches the cloak. Layered black-and-ivory rooftops and power lines below, a few windblown ink leaves, sharp architectural drawing. Red sky occupies top 60%, dark figure strong isolated silhouette against red, no red sun. Threatening cinematic stillness, dramatic perspective. Black ink, ivory paper highlights, flat red sky only. Keep the rival visibly different from the hilltop hero: short silver hair, black cloak, no ivory scarf. Original character not based on any franchise. No text, no logos, no borders, no violence, no blood, no wounds.

artworks.name: Glance
artworks.prompt: Create the next original manga frame featuring the exact same silver-haired rival from the first reference. The second reference gives the story's pen-and-ink style. Landscape 16:9 close-up from shoulders up. He turns his head over his LEFT shoulder to stare directly toward the viewer with a sharp, knowing sideways glance. Short swept-back ivory/silver hair, dark high-collared cloak, defined angular adult male face, both eyes visible, dark pupils subtly looking LEFT. Position face at CENTER, so both eyes are visible on mobile crops. Flat vivid red #cb2724 background with a few black diagonal ink strokes. Masterful fine engraved linework with strong black shadows and offwhite skin/hair. Tense but controlled expression, original face, consistent costume. No text, speech balloons, logos, borders, no wounds or blood. Highly detailed hand drawn graphic novel art, not photographic or 3D.

artworks.name: HeroFighter
artworks.prompt: Create an isolated full-body action illustration of the exact original black-haired, ivory-scarfed swordsman from the reference. This image is a transparent foreground sprite for a cinematic website. Landscape 3:2. He is on the LEFT two-thirds of image, facing and lunging to the RIGHT in profile, feet visible, realistic dynamic anatomy, two hands gripping the deep emerald green hilt of an UNSHEATHED slender steel katana. Katana held diagonally UPWARD from his hands near center at y=55% to its blade tip at x=90%, y=12%. The full sword and full body must be visible with margin. Black kimono and loose dark trousers, long black ponytail, ivory scarf flowing far left. Fine detailed black-and-ivory manga engraving, expressive black shadow, matching reference style and identity, only green color on sword grip. Dynamic cloth, restrained movement strokes. NO other character, no ground, no scenery, no rectangular backdrop, no typography. Genuine transparent alpha around silhouette. No blood, no injuries, no flames. Beautiful polished line art with high detail, not a 3D render.

artworks.name: EnemyFighter
artworks.prompt: Create an isolated full-body action illustration of the same silver-haired rival from reference one. Reference two shows the OTHER fighter and the exact ink drawing style; do NOT reproduce that fighter. This is a transparent foreground layer for an animated sword clash. Landscape 3:2. The silver-haired rival is on the RIGHT two-thirds of image, lunging to the LEFT in profile, entire body and feet visible. Short swept-back ivory hair, black high-collared cloak streaming far RIGHT, dark boots. Both hands grip a crimson-red wrapped katana handle near the CENTER at y=53%. The unsheathed steel katana angles UP toward the upper LEFT, its tip near x=10%, y=10%; whole sword in frame. This mirrored trajectory will meet the other fighter's blade. Powerful controlled posture, real human anatomy, detailed fabric. Beautiful fine black and ivory pen-and-ink engraving matching the references, only crimson red on the handle. No other person, no background, no floor, no horizon, no text, no rectangular border. Genuine alpha transparency around entire silhouette. No blood or injuries. Original graphic-novel character, not a 3D render.

artworks.name: Wind
artworks.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Create an original premium collectible katana product illustration for the brand LocalNinja, the WIND edition. Wide landscape 3:1 composition. EXACTLY one complete unsheathed katana and one matching scabbard isolated on a transparent background, aligned horizontally left-to-right with handle at LEFT and sword tip at RIGHT. Entire sword and sheath fully visible with generous margins. Slender polished silver curved blade with a subtle elegant edge pattern, exquisitely detailed dark bronze circular guard engraved with flowing wind lines, rich EMERALD GREEN braided handle wrap over ivory diamond underlay, small bronze fittings. Below the sword, parallel, a deep emerald green lacquer scabbard with one small flowing silver wind motif and emerald cord. Beautiful detailed black pen-and-ink engraving style with refined silver highlights, matches mature manga editorial art but with precise convincing product proportions. The accent green should be saturated and clearly green, not cyan or olive. No text, no typography, no lettering, no logos, no smoke, no effects, no scenery, no hands, no display stand, no extra swords. True alpha transparency outside both objects, no cast shadows. This is a fictional product illustration, not an instructional diagram.

artworks.prompt: Create the WATER edition of this original LocalNinja katana product. Change emerald green to rich saturated COBALT BLUE for the handle braid, scabbard lacquer and cord. Change bronze fittings to dark brushed silver. Replace the scabbard wind motif and guard engraving with elegant flowing silver ocean-wave motifs. Keep it visibly a different elemental model with a beautiful wave-shaped guard design. No text, no typography, no new objects, no extra swords, no stand, no smoke, no background, no cast shadows. Full objects in frame. Genuine alpha transparency. Landscape 3:1.
